description_en: Queries the list of configurations for modifying HTTP incoming response headers of a site
description_zh: 查询站点的修改HTTP入站响应头的配置列表，
name: ListHttpIncomingResponseHeaderModificationRules

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can obtain this by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The configuration ID. You can obtain this by calling the ListHttpIncomingResponseHeaderModificationRules operation
parameters.name: config_id

parameters.help_en:
The configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global configurations or rule configurations. Valid values:

- global: queries global configurations.
- rule: queries rule configurations
parameters.help_zh:
配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者规则配置，取值范围：

- global：查询全局配置；
- rule：查询规则配置；
parameters.name: config_type

parameters.help_en: The page number for a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. The default value is version 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version
